final: WITH circuit_rounds AS (SELECT r.circuitId, c.country, AVG(r.round) AS round_average FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY r.circuitId, c.country), country_rounds AS (SELECT country, AVG(round_average) AS country_average FROM circuit_rounds GROUP BY country) SELECT cr.circuitId, cr.country, cr.round_average, cr.round_average - co.country_average AS difference FROM circuit_rounds AS cr JOIN country_rounds AS co ON cr.country = co.country ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
